title: Product Specification Sheet — Vitamin B12 (Product Code 64)

golden_provenance.notes: Authored from 200-DPI renders of the committed excerpt; the extractor's output was read only after the golden was written. UNREVIEWED by a human.

known_defects.summary: Distinct metadata field lines are merged into one run-on paragraph
known_defects.evidence: 'Intended Use: Food Supplement Applications Product Code: 64 Revision Date: 06/14/2025 Country of Origin: Brazil' is one output line; the page shows four separate lines. Likewise the title line merges 'Product Specification Sheet' with 'Ingredient: Vitamin B12'.
known_defects.root_cause: PyFPDF sets a uniform 28.35pt leading for 12pt text (2.36x) and 56.69pt between blocks. The merger keys on the leading jump alone, so every same-leading line pair is joined regardless of how short the preceding line is.
known_defects.proposed_fix: Do not treat a line as continued when the preceding line ends far short of the column's right edge. Measured fill for the wrongly merged lines is 17-45%; the one genuine continuation follows a 100%-fill line, so the signal separates cleanly here.
known_defects.business_impact: Destroys key:value structure in product specs — the single largest template family in the mirror.

known_defects.summary: Glyphs from the base-14 Symbol font decode to Latin lookalikes
known_defects.evidence: Content stream is '/F3 10 Tf <a3> Tj' where object 4 is '/BaseFont /Symbol'. Symbol 0xA3 is lessequal; output is '£'. Symbol 0xB3 is greaterequal; output is '‡'. Both match Adobe StandardEncoding (0xA3 sterling, 0xB3 daggerdbl).
known_defects.root_cause: fonts.rs consults decode_symbol_fallback only after Document::decode_text yields U+FFFD. For a /Symbol font with no /Encoding, lopdf returns a plausible non-replacement character, so the fallback never runs and base14::builtin_encoding_char is used for widths only.
known_defects.proposed_fix: When BaseFont normalizes to Symbol or ZapfDingbats and the font dict carries no /Encoding override, decode bytes through base14::builtin_encoding_char before the generic decode_text path.
known_defects.business_impact: Inverts the meaning of every tolerance in the document (<= becomes a currency symbol).
